context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) The /api/aurem-dev/chat/stream SSE framing uses two non-obvious shapes: token frames are {"token": "…"} with NO `type` field, and meta frames are {"meta": true, "provider": "…"} also with NO `type` field. The first meta frame carries provider='aurem-cto' as a placeholder; the SECOND meta frame (emitted after the LLM resolves) carries the real provider (e.g. 'glm-5.2'). Always overwrite, do not first-wins. 2) Heartbeat frames {"thinking": true, "elapsed_s": …, "activity": "asking GLM-5.2…"} stream every ~600ms — these are NOT step frames (no `type: step`) so they don't inflate step count. 3) On the ora happy path expect exactly 2 step frames: '🤔 Thinking…' (done:false) and '✅ Done' (done:true). >4 = orchestrator fall-through bug. 4) End-of-stream is a {"done": true, "provider": "…", …} frame with no `type` field — also carries final provider. 5) Each live test costs ~6s of GLM time; the 9-test suite runs in ~76s. 6) Backend URL via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var (preview = launch-pad-237.preview.emergentagent.com). 7) Iter 212m-21 source tests use brittle hard-coded slice windows around the activity label — widen them if you add inline comments to the ora branch.
rca_of_the_issue: BUG (founder report): Ask Advisor returning one-line dead-end replies instead of completing the analysis or asking a clarifying question. ROOT CAUSES (all three combined, fix needed all three): (a) ORA_PANEL_TONE had a hard '150 words max' + '3 lines max' ceiling that told GLM to truncate — even for ambiguous prompts where a clarifying question is the right move. (b) max_tokens=1500 in routers/chat.py line ~1656 truncated longer answers mid-sentence. (c) No explicit rule banning one-line dead-end replies — model was free to pick the shortest valid completion. FIXES (applied by main agent, verified by this test pass): (1) Removed the 150-word/3-line caps from ORA_PANEL_TONE. (2) Added R5 'ALWAYS GIVE A COMPLETE RESPONSE' rule that explicitly bans one-liners and mandates either full answer OR specific clarifying question naming the missing fact. (3) Bumped max_tokens 1500 → 2500. VERIFICATION: live test on preview with prompt 'Help me fix it' now returns 720-char clarifying question listing 4 specific candidate failure modes the user can pick from (error message? feature behavior? build/deploy? specific file?) — exactly per R5 spec. Stream closes cleanly with ✅ Done(done:true) — no premature disconnect. provider='glm-5.2' confirms Iter 212m-21 routing intact.
